title: Mango and honey parfaits with cashew cream
blurb: Layers of fresh mango, toasted almonds and smooth cashew cream sweetened with honey. A simple make-ahead dessert that needs no cooking.
steps: Soak the cashews in cold water for at least 2 hours, then drain well.
Toast the flaked almonds in a dry pan over medium heat until golden, shaking often, then set aside to cool.
Put the drained cashews, measured water and honey in a blender and blend until completely smooth and creamy.
Peel the mango and cut the flesh into small chunks.
Divide half the mango between four glasses, then spoon over half the cashew cream.
Scatter over half the raspberries and half the toasted almonds, then repeat the layers with the remaining ingredients.
Chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes before serving.
